hero.status: Free pilot programme for private schools in Cameroon
hero.title: School fees paid on time, without chasing parents.
hero.lead: Payskool reminds every parent by SMS before each instalment, follows up with those who are late, records every payment at the cash desk and shows you at any time who has paid and who still owes.
hero.note: Free during the pilot, SMS included.

problem.title: You spend your days asking for instalments.

items.title: Reminders by hand
items.text: Calls one by one, notes in the homework diary, meetings with parents. Hours of office time every month, often for the same families.

items.title: Late payments found too late
items.text: You notice a class has not paid when teachers' salaries are due, when it is too late to follow up.

items.title: Sending pupils home
items.text: When nothing else worked, children get sent home. Nobody likes it, neither the school nor the parents.

items.title: “I already paid”
items.text: Without a shared record, every dispute means digging through receipt books while a parent waits.

problem.turn: Payskool sends the reminders and follow-ups for you, records every franc collected and shows you at any time who still owes what.

how.title: The life of an instalment, from reminder to receipt

steps.title: The reminder goes out on its own
steps.text: A few days before the due date, every parent concerned gets an SMS with the amount and the date. Nobody has to write it.

steps.title: If the due date passes, a follow-up goes out
steps.text: A day, a week, a month after: the follow-up goes out while the instalment is unpaid, and stops as soon as it is paid.

steps.title: The parent pays at the cash desk
steps.text: The cashier finds the pupil, sees their instalments, confirms the amount and takes the payment. It is recorded under their name.

steps.title: The receipt arrives by SMS
steps.text: The parent gets the confirmation straight away, with what is left to pay. The printed receipt carries a number and a QR code.

steps.title: Your dashboard updates
steps.text: Collected, still to collect, late payments by class: the picture changes with every payment, with nothing to copy out.

how.soon: Next: payment by MTN MoMo and Orange Money from home, without going to the cash desk.

items.title: Money comes in sooner
items.text: Parents are told before the due date, not three weeks after. Those who forget are followed up without you having to think about it.

items.title: Your office breathes again
items.text: No more calls one by one or lists copied by hand. The time saved goes back to pupils and parents.

items.title: You know where you stand
items.text: Collected, still to collect and late payments by class, on your phone, at any time. You plan salaries without surprises.

items.title: Fewer disputes at the cash desk
items.text: Every payment has its receipt and its record. A dispute is settled in seconds, in front of the parent.

desk.title: A cash desk you control, even when you are not behind it.
desk.text: Every franc collected is recorded under the name of the cashier who took it. No more recounting receipt books in the evening.

points.title: Every payment has a name
points.text: Cashier, time, amount, pupil, instalment: everything is recorded, nothing gets lost.

points.title: A numbered receipt
points.text: With a QR code, printed and sent by SMS. A forged receipt matches nothing in your register.

points.title: Mistakes are fixed without crossing out
points.text: A wrong entry is cancelled by a reverse entry, with its reason. The history is never erased.

pilot.title: The pilot programme
pilot.intro: Payskool is being finalised, and we are opening the pilot to a small group of private schools in Cameroon, from nursery to secondary. The first phase covers the cash desk, receipts, the instalment schedule and SMS reminders; payment by MTN MoMo and Orange Money comes next. During the pilot it is free; in return, you tell us what works and what is missing.
offer: Payskool free for the whole pilot
Reminder, follow-up and receipt SMS included
Your pupils, instalments and parents' numbers imported from your Excel files, with you
A direct WhatsApp line to the team
pilot.after: After the pilot: a monthly subscription and SMS charged per message, at prices announced before the pilot ends, with no commission on your collections. You then decide whether to continue.

steps.title: We meet
steps.text: Message us on WhatsApp: we come to your school for a demonstration.

steps.title: We set up your school
steps.text: Classes, instalments, due dates and parents' numbers, imported from your Excel files.

steps.title: The first reminders go out
steps.text: Your parents get their first SMS reminders, and your cashiers take payments on Payskool.

items.a: The product is being finalised and the pilot programme is open. The first phase covers the cash desk, receipts, the instalment schedule and SMS reminders; Mobile Money payment follows, school by school.

items.q: Not all our parents have a smartphone. Does it still work?
items.a: Yes. Reminders, follow-ups and receipts go out by SMS: they reach any phone, even the most basic one. Parents have nothing to install.

items.q: How much do the SMS cost?
items.a: During the pilot, they are included. After that, they are charged per message, at a price announced before the pilot ends. A short message fits in a single SMS, and the settings screen shows you what each message costs before you switch it on.

items.q: Can I change the messages and the sending days?
items.a: Yes. You choose the days before and after the due date, the sending hours and the text of each message. The parent's name, the pupil's name, the amount and the date are filled in automatically.
Messages go out during the day, Monday to Saturday, never more than two follow-ups a week for the same pupil, and they stop as soon as the instalment is paid.

items.q: What about a family going through a hard time?
items.a: You can pause follow-ups for a pupil while a payment arrangement is in place.

items.q: Do we have to type in all our pupils again?
items.a: No. Your pupil lists and parents' numbers are imported from an Excel file. During the pilot, we do it with you.

items.q: Will parents be able to pay by Mobile Money?
items.a: Yes, in a second phase: MTN MoMo and Orange Money, from home. The money will go straight to your school's merchant account, opened with a payment aggregator. It will never go through Payskool.

items.q: Can a wrong entry be corrected?
items.a: Yes, without crossing out: the mistake is cancelled by a reverse entry, with its reason, and both stay visible in the history. That protects your cashiers as much as your cash desk.
Nothing during the pilot, SMS included. After that, a fixed monthly subscription and SMS charged per message, at prices announced before the pilot ends, with no commission on your collections.

items.q: Does Payskool handle grades and report cards?
items.a: No. Payskool only deals with money: fees, instalments, reminders, cash desk and receipts. It works alongside your school management software.

about.heroTitle: Building the financial future of education in Africa
about.heroSubtitle: Payskool was born from a profound conviction: the quality of education depends on the financial strength of the institutions that provide it. We give promoters absolute control over their cash flow.
about.manifestoP1: Running a school today is a constant challenge. Beyond educational excellence, promoters and founders face a complex reality on the ground: the archaic management of financial flows. Between the burden of handling cash, the risk of funds evaporating at the counter, and the tedious management of fake payment slips, leaders' energy is too often absorbed by administrative tasks instead of being invested in growth.
about.manifestoP2: Worse still, this financial opacity isolates institutions. Without a certified and unalterable revenue history, it becomes extremely difficult to prove solvency to banking partners. The result? Credit refusals or unsuitable financing conditions, which hinder or completely block expansion projects, the purchase of school buses, or the modernization of classrooms.
about.manifestoP3: It is against this backdrop that Payskool was created. We have brought together a team of experts in finance and educational management to build the benchmark platform dedicated to the African school ecosystem. More than just a collection solution, Payskool acts as the true trusted ally of promoters, transforming cash management into a powerful lever for peace of mind and development.
about.commitmentsTitle: Our commitments to the educational ecosystem
about.commitment1Desc: We put an end to the evaporation of funds. Every franc collected, whether at the counter or via Mobile Money, is timestamped, tracked, and recorded in an unalterable ledger. With Payskool, the tolerance for cash leakage is zero. Your financial data is encrypted and protected.
about.commitment2Desc: Designed 100% for the reality on the ground in Africa, our platform integrates natively with Mobile Money operators and local banking networks. We offer parents a smooth and frictionless payment experience, respecting their habits and guaranteeing transaction speed.
about.commitment3Desc: We give control back to leaders. With live visibility into cash flow and collections, promoters make informed decisions with total peace of mind. No more gray areas and nasty accounting surprises at the end of the month.
about.commitment4Desc: Our mission goes beyond securing payments. By certifying your regular revenue streams, Payskool provides you with a true passport to credit. We actively support you in financing your infrastructure by strengthening your credibility with lending institutions.
about.impact1Desc: The integrity of your revenue is guaranteed, every transaction is certified and unforgeable.
about.impact2Desc: The average collection level observed by our partner institutions in their first year.
about.impact3Desc: The volume of management, reconciliation, and paperwork hours saved by your administrative teams.
about.impact4Desc: Maximum availability of our platform to ensure continuous service.
about.ctaTitle: Let's build the school of tomorrow together.
about.ctaDesc: The independence and growth of your institution begin with serene and controlled financial management. Let's discuss your current challenges and discover how Payskool can secure and transform your daily life.

careers.heroTitle: Join the mission. Let's secure education in Africa.
careers.heroSubtitle: At Payskool, we don't just build collection software. We build the financial infrastructure that enables private schools to grow with peace of mind and shape the future of millions of students.
careers.cultureIntro: We are a team of builders. We combine the technical excellence of the world's top Fintechs with a deep and authentic understanding of African realities on the ground.
careers.culture1Desc: What you code, design, or sell today saves a school's cash flow tomorrow. At Payskool, your work doesn't get lost in a backlog: it has a tangible and immediate impact on the survival of educational institutions.
careers.culture2Desc: We manage the financial flows of education. Approximation is not an option; rigor is our foundation. We make no compromises on the security and reliability of our systems.
careers.culture3Desc: We master the complex reality of Mobile Money and cash payments in Africa, and we bring the most advanced software architectures on the market to it.
careers.culture4Desc: Like our product, our internal culture values clarity. Information flows freely, successes are celebrated as a team, and failures are our best learning opportunities.
careers.perksIntro: To solve complex problems, you need a free mind. We take care of our team so they can give their best.
careers.perk1Desc: Remote-friendly policy or hybrid work: choose the environment where you perform best.
careers.perk2Desc: Latest generation MacBook Pro provided from your first day, so your tools match your talent.
careers.perk3Desc: Top-tier premium health coverage for you and your family. Your peace of mind is our priority.
careers.perk4Desc: An annual budget allocated to your personal training (online courses, tech conferences, books of your choice).
careers.ctaDesc: We are always looking for brilliant, unconventional profiles deeply driven by the desire to make an impact. If you think you can bring unique value to Payskool's mission, don't be shy.

job.applyDesc: Send us your CV (or LinkedIn profile) and a short note about your motivations.

fullstack.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (NestJS / React)
fullstack.aboutText: We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to lead the development of our collection and financing platform. You will be responsible for designing robust architectures capable of securely processing millions of financial transactions.
fullstack.resp1: Design and develop new features in TypeScript (NestJS, React, Prisma).
fullstack.resp2: Ensure the security, performance, and reliability of the platform handling high transaction volumes.
fullstack.resp3: Mentor team engineers and spread technical best practices.
fullstack.req1: 5+ years of full-stack development experience (Node.js/NestJS, React, TypeScript).
fullstack.req2: Significant experience in designing financial (Fintech) or transactional applications.
fullstack.req3: Excellent mastery of PostgreSQL and complex data modeling.
fullstack.ben2: Premium equipment (MacBook Pro) and top-tier health insurance.

product-designer.title: Fintech UX/UI Product Designer
product-designer.aboutText: You will be the guardian of the user experience on Payskool. Your mission: transform complex financial flows into simple, reassuring, and extremely intuitive interfaces for school promoters and parents.
product-designer.resp1: Design user journeys from A to Z (Wireframes, Prototypes, High-Fidelity Mockups on Figma).
product-designer.resp2: Maintain and enrich our B2B Design System.
product-designer.resp3: Conduct user research and usability testing with our clients (school directors, cashiers).
product-designer.req1: 3+ years of Product Design (UX/UI) experience, ideally on SaaS B2B or Fintech products.
product-designer.req2: Ability to popularize complexity: you know how to turn a financial dashboard into a clear experience.
product-designer.req3: Excellent mastery of Figma and accessibility best practices.
product-designer.ben1: Major impact on a product used by dozens of schools.
product-designer.ben2: Total autonomy over design direction and a training budget.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.description: The data the Payskool website processes, and the data it does not.

sections.heading: What this page covers
paragraphs: This policy covers the Payskool presentation website. Data a school processes in the software (pupils, parents, payments) is governed by the agreement signed with that school.

sections.heading: No account, no audience measurement
paragraphs: The website offers no account creation. It uses no audience measurement tool, no advertising and no tracking pixel.

sections.heading: Pilot programme request
paragraphs: The request form stores nothing. The server puts the school name, city and number of pupils into a message, then opens WhatsApp with that message pre-filled. Nothing reaches us until you send it from WhatsApp.

Once the message is sent, we receive your WhatsApp number and the message content. We use them only to answer your request and organise the pilot. WhatsApp, a Meta service, processes these exchanges under its own terms.

sections.heading: Technical logs
paragraphs: Like any web server, the one hosting this website may record technical logs (IP address, date, page requested, browser) to keep it secure and running.

sections.heading: Receipt check
paragraphs: The check field on the home page runs entirely in your browser, on a fictitious receipt. The number you type is sent to no server.

sections.heading: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask to access, correct or delete the data about you, and object to its use. Write to contact@lehmora.com or on WhatsApp.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.description: The rules for using the Payskool website.

sections.heading: Purpose
paragraphs: These terms govern the use of the Payskool presentation website. A school's use of the software is covered by a separate written agreement made with each school.

sections.heading: A product in its pilot phase
paragraphs: Payskool is under development and open to a limited number of pilot schools. The features described on this website may change. They are neither a binding offer nor an availability commitment.

sections.heading: Payments
paragraphs: Payskool is software, not a payment institution. Mobile Money payments go through the aggregator chosen by the school and land in the school's own merchant account. Payskool receives, holds and pays out no funds.

sections.heading: Liability
paragraphs: We take care to keep the information on this website accurate and up to date, without being able to guarantee it. Third-party services the website links to, such as WhatsApp, are responsible for their own content.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: The only cookie the Payskool website sets, and why.

sections.heading: A single cookie
paragraphs: The website sets a single cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers the language you chose (French or English). It is needed for the website to work, holds no personal data and is deleted when you close your browser.

sections.heading: No trackers
paragraphs: No audience measurement, advertising or social media cookie is used. That is why the website shows no consent banner.

sections.heading: Removing it
paragraphs: You can delete or block this cookie in your browser settings. The website still works: it will then use your browser's language.
